notes: The 262143-token TP4 prefill probes use real checkpoint weights and verify a finite last-token result for both layer kinds.
The last-position TP4 decode probes use replicated page tables/current positions, device-initialized KV history, sentinel readback, trace capture/replay, and deterministic repeat replay.
Logical S=33 prefill plus decode verifies non-tile-aligned tails, local cache ownership, and bit-exact output replicas.
The capacity-required BFP4 exception is limited to TP1 full-attention expert gate/up weights and passes representative prefill/decode PCC 0.995.
BF16 embedding plus a separate BF16 LM head require 2952790016 bytes on TP1 and do not fit after the decoder/KV placement plus final norm and the operating reserve.
Full-stack placement therefore requires downstream embedding and LM-head storage in BFP8_B; this decoder stage records but does not implement or claim terminal/logit correctness for that policy.

The operating reserve includes the configured 64 MiB trace region, all conservatively source-live prefill tensors, and the prior profile-specific allocator slack; chunked SDPA does not bound the full QKV or inherited residual lifetime.

Packed expert decode retains an additional physical BFP8 tensor per layer and is selected on TP4 only. Capacity disables TP2's 8088453120-byte retained copy; TP4 retains 4411883520 packed-expert bytes plus 642611200 bytes of prior O/dense copies.

TP1 packed expert decode is disabled by a hard capacity limit: even the unselected all-BFP4 physical-tile lower bound is 8564244480 bytes, larger than its 7075084288-byte decoder-stage headroom at the reduced context.

At 262144 tokens the conservative TP1 full-stack projection is 56398546944 bytes, so the shared 32 GiB device cannot honor the advertised prefill context with the correctness-proven precision policy. The per-profile hard limit is 50624; 50623 is the tighter nonaligned boundary and 50625 is rejected before device allocation.
TP2 and TP4 preserve the advertised 262144-token contract with conservative headroom of 788749312 and 939828224 bytes per device.
P150 real-weight representative-layer probes pass at both the 50623-token nonaligned boundary and aligned 50624-token limit; 50625 is rejected safely before device allocation.
The earlier P150 53343/53344 real-weight probes also passed but are superseded/non-boundary evidence after conservatively accounting for both accumulated chunks and a newly allocated concat output.
